lines.t: You've been wandering along in the valley of night
Looking for hope in the absence of light
The weight of the world is a heavy chain
But there's a fire that can break the pain
Don't look back to the empty hollow
There's a narrow path for you to follow
Lion of Judah, you're the king of the soul's design
In the glory of the light you shine
Holy Savior, you're the rock where the broken stand
With the victory in your hand
Run to spirit
The enemy whispers, he's coming for you
But he's a liar and the word is true
Between the velvet and the iron gates
The savior's mercy is the only way
Death is defeated
The stone is rolled away
Fall on your knees
Lying on Tudor
You're the king of the soul's design
In the glory of the light you shine
Holy Savior, you're the rock where the broken stand
With the victory in your hand
The light is calling, you're the only one
Yeah, the victory is won
